title_card.kicker: Broad Sky Partners · Portfolio Resource Group
title_card.headline: One operating picture for six platforms.

narration: Tyler, this is Broad Sky Operating Intelligence: one working system for six platforms, on verified data.

action_args.text: Show me how to take Punctual Pros nationwide

narration: Ask it what you would ask an associate: how do we take Punctual Pros nationwide? It answers from filings, deed records and add-on screens.
For Punctual Pros, the live forecast becomes a staffing plan for each hub before the calls arrive.
For CET, 183 treatment plants are ranked for Horton, and 157 add-on targets are screened.
The bigger question is value at exit. Each platform gets an operating system aimed at the KPIs that move its multiple.
ServiceOS gives Punctual Pros weather-driven dispatch, AI call answering and a membership engine.
GridOS moves CET from bid radar to recurring maintenance contracts.
FirmOS gives every Frontline law firm a security score and cleaner eBilling.
LabOS lowers Thomas Scientific's cost to serve on every order, through punchout and account-health scoring.
SignalOS and HarborOS complete the set: an estimated six to twelve million dollars of investment across all six.
The calculator turns EBITDA uplift and multiple expansion into equity value, every assumption labelled.

title_card.headline: Start with ServiceOS. A 90-day pilot plan at the next PRG meeting.

narration: Our recommendation: start with ServiceOS at Punctual Pros, with a ninety-day pilot plan at the next PRG meeting.
